sections.chapter_title: Ethernet (ETH): gigabit media access control (GMAC) with DMA controller
sections.text_helper: Section 76.2.5 "Bus interface features" in chapter 76 (Ethernet (ETH): gigabit media access control (GMAC) with DMA controller), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3976.
sections.section_content:
AXI master interface
The AXI master interface features are the following:
• Interfaces with the application through AXI4 compatible interface
• 32-bit address width
• 64-bit data
• OKAY, SLVERR, and DECERR responses
• Software-selected type of AXI burst (fixed and variable length burst) in AXI master
interface; extended length fixed bursts of 32, 64, 128, and 256
• Handshaking on AXI read and write data channels
AHB slave interface
The AHB slave interface supports the following features:
• Interfaces with the application through AHB
• AHB slave interface (32-bit) for CSR access
• All AHB burst types
The AHB slave interface does not generate the following responses:
• Split
• Retry
